A "Done" label now shows next to the button, so the click registered.

DONE

The list now reads Print slides, Test projector, Share notes, Update roster, Draft agenda, and I pressed Done. I got there with two drags: Print slides to the top, then Draft agenda to the bottom.

After pressing Done, a second "Done" label appeared next to the button. I took it as a confirmation, but BenchLab didn't say what it meant. BenchLab is still open.

DONE

BLOCKED: I couldn't make the Share button appear, so I never clicked it.

I tried several ways of hovering over the Actions strip, none of which revealed the action buttons:
- moving the real desktop pointer onto and around the strip
- moving the agent cursor with a window target
- foreground clicks and drags, and a scroll over the strip
- pressing Tab

The only things I clicked were the "Actions" pill and empty parts of the strip. No action button was clicked, and BenchLab is still open.

I clicked Pin once. BenchLab now shows "Last action: Pin", and I didn't click Rename, Export or Archive. The app is still open.
